html:
Confucius was born, by tradition, in 551 BCE near Qufu in the small state of Lu, in what is now Shandong province in eastern China. The year is the traditional one; some sources give 552 BCE.

He was born Kong Qiu. His father, a soldier of minor noble rank, was old when he was born and died when the boy was about three. He grew up poor, raised by his mother, and had to make his way through learning and small official jobs.

The world he was born into was the Spring and Autumn period. The Zhou kings still reigned, but they had lost real power. Great lords and ministers fought for control inside states like Lu, and the old rites and loyalties were breaking down. Confucius later looked back to the early Zhou as a golden age of order and virtue.

His birth date became a holiday. In Taiwan his birthday, set on 28 September, is Teachers' Day. Each year a large ceremony is held at the Temple of Confucius in Qufu, his home town, where his family, the Kongs, lived for more than seventy generations.

The birth is close in time to other great teachers. The Buddha and Mahavira in India, and Laozi in tradition, lived in the same few centuries, a period some historians call the Axial Age.
sum: Confucius was born, by tradition, in 551 BCE near Qufu in the small state of Lu, in what is now Shandong province in eastern China. The year is the traditional one; some sources give 552 BCE.
